papers.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
papers.summary: This survey unifies video understanding and generation through world modeling, organizing progress around inferring, synthesizing, sharing, and interacting with latent temporal states to emphasize persistent dynamics over clip-level perception.

papers.title: RoboJudge: Multimodal Language Models as Judges for Embodied Video Generation
papers.summary: Researchers introduce a benchmark and training dataset to evaluate multimodal language models as judges of physically valid, instruction-aligned embodied video generation, yielding a fine-tuned 9B judge with high human agreement.

papers.title: SliderEdit++: Improved Slider Trajectories in Instruction-Based Image Editing
papers.summary: SlideBench benchmarks continuous image editing and SliderEdit++ improves slider reliability via trajectory regularization and disentanglement for smoother, faster control.

papers.title: MMVistaReason: Toward Open-Data and Post-Training Recipes for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.summary: MMVistaReason improves open multimodal reasoning through structured data construction, difficulty-aware distillation, and specialized reinforcement learning integration.

papers.title: Co-adaptive Rule Routing and Constraining for Structured Knowledge Retrieval
papers.summary: CoRE jointly learns reasoning rules and constrained evidence retrieval through alternating reinforcement and contrastive learning without predefined query-rule supervision.
